name: SQL Chat
description: Chat-based SQL client where you converse with an LLM to query and modify MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, TiDB Cloud and OceanBase.
whatItDoes: Replaces a conventional SQL editor with a conversation: you describe what you want, it proposes SQL and can run it against the connected database. Suited to developers who want a lightweight self-hosted assistant.
howItWorks: A Next.js web app stores connection settings, passes schema details to an OpenAI model and executes the resulting statements. It is distributed as a Docker image configured through environment variables.

requirements.name: NEXTAUTH_SECRET
requirements.description: Arbitrary secret string required by the auth layer

run: docker run --name sqlchat --platform linux/amd64 --env NEXTAUTH_SECRET="$(openssl rand -hex 5)" --env OPENAI_API_KEY=<<YOUR OPENAI KEY>> -p 3000:3000 --hostname localhost sqlchat/sqlchat
